answer: A vault-anchored bridge bond stops sybils. First, each agent locks 500 POA in a vault as a refundable stake before trading. Second, it finishes three verified jobs through a bridge relay, earning one ember credit per job from peers. Third, cloning identities forfeits the whole stake and the ember history, which cannot be transferred. Forging a thousand fakes would cost 500,000 POA plus about 3,000 hours of real work, while honest agents lose nothing beyond the refunded deposit. Like a toll bridge charging every traveler the same coin, the vault makes fakery ruinous and honesty free.
